episodes.title: Pilot (1)
episodes.summary: After her father dies, Mike leaves Boston for Colorado Springs, where she sets up practice and adopts three orphans.

episodes.title: Epidemic
episodes.summary: While trying to stave off an influenza epidemic, Dr. Mike falls prey to the deadly virus, leaving the town in jeopardy.

episodes.title: The Visitor
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike's disapproving mother visits from Boston and finds her daughter's unconventional life on the frontier difficult to accept.

episodes.title: Law Of The Land
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike hires a retired gunslinger as sheriff to save the life of an orphaned immigrant who stole a cow to feed his starving family.

episodes.title: The Healing
episodes.summary: A bitter Loren, who blames Sully for his daughter's death, tries to repossess Dr. Mike's cabin when he learns he still owns the deed.

episodes.title: Father's Day
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike is suspicious when Charlotte's husband returns to the children he abandoned and tries to convince the town that he has changed.

episodes.title: Bad Water
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike threatens a wealthy mining baron when mercury from his mine contaminates the town's water supply and causes illness in the community.

episodes.title: The Great American Medicine Show
episodes.summary: When a medicine-show man arrives in town, selling an elixir he claims will cure anything, Dr. Mike becomes determined to prove him a fraud.

episodes.title: A Cowboy's Lullaby
episodes.summary: A thieving cowhand rides into town and quickly disappears after robbing Loren's store and leaving his sick baby with Dr. Mike.

episodes.title: Running Ghost
episodes.summary: When Sully is beaten and left for dead by skinners who are slaughtering buffalo, Dr. Mike fears he may be paralyzed.

episodes.title: The Prisoner
episodes.summary: After Gen. Custer injures Cloud Dancing and sentences him to hang, Dr. Mike and Sully orchestrate his escape.

episodes.title: Happy Birthday
episodes.summary: A lonely Dr. Mike believes the whole town feels sorry for her as she prepares to celebrate another birthday as an unmarried woman.

episodes.title: Rite Of Passage
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike is at odds with Matthew when he announces his decision to forgo a university education and marry Ingrid.

episodes.title: Heroes
episodes.summary: Influenced by romance novels, Colleen develops a crush on Sully and endangers her life when she sets up a situation in which he must rescue her.

episodes.title: The Operation
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike is forced to operate on Brian after he suffers a severe head injury; the townspeople argue over the construction of a new school.

episodes.title: The Secret
episodes.summary: When one of Dr. Mike's patients dies and leaves behind an illegitimate child, Hank is forced to admit he is the boy's father.

episodes.title: Portraits
episodes.summary: When a famous Civil War photographer arrives to take a town portrait, he is delayed by bickering, and Dr. Mike discovers he is going blind.

episodes.title: The Race
episodes.summary: Rules forbid Mike from entering her horse in an important race; Brian faces discrimination in a cooking contest.

episodes.title: Sanctuary
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike must use medical evidence to prove Loren's sister-in-law did not murder her abusive husband.

episodes.title: Halloween
episodes.summary: It's Halloween and the residents of town are getting spooked by a vision of a man who mysteriously appears and disappears in various parts of town. Meanwhile, Dr. Mike receives a visit from Sully's deceased wife that causes her to rethink her relationship with him, and after talking with some friends at school, Brian starts to suspect that Dorothy is a witch.

episodes.title: The Incident
episodes.summary: When Jake is accused of killing a Cheyenne, the divided town depends on Sully's peacemaking ability to avoid retribution.

episodes.title: Saving Souls
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike clashes with a faith healer over the necessity of Kid Cole's treatment; Robert E and Grace encounter problems when they plan to marry.

episodes.title: Where the Heart Is (1)
episodes.summary: In Boston to care for her ailing mother, Mike meets a doctor; Sully follows, wondering whether he should fight to win her.

episodes.title: Where the Heart Is (2)
episodes.summary: Michaela "Mike" Quinn heads back to Boston upon word that her mother is seriously ill, and Sully's arrival causes a stir in Boston, where Mike is feeling at home.

episodes.title: Giving Thanks
episodes.summary: When Colorado Springs is hit by a severe drought, Jake and Loren put the townspeople in danger by stealing water from the Cheyenne.

episodes.title: Best Friends
episodes.summary: On the eve of the Sweethearts Dance, Mike sees Sully with Dorothy, and Colleen is accused of stealing a friend's boyfriend.

episodes.title: Sully's Choice
episodes.summary: When a misunderstanding leads the cavalry to place a bounty on Sully, Matthew, Colleen and Brian hide their injured friend.

episodes.title: "Mike's Dream: A Christmas Tale"
episodes.summary: While caring for a pregnant woman on Christmas Eve, Dr. Mike is visited by the spirit of Charlotte Cooper.

episodes.title: Crossing the Line
episodes.summary: A cave-in traps Matthew, bringing Sully to the rescue; Loren refuses credit to strikers, prompting a boycott of his store.

episodes.title: The Offering
episodes.summary: Mike feels responsible for typhus transmitted to the Cheyenne through government-issued blankets she urged them to accept.

episodes.title: The Circus
episodes.summary: When a woman brings her traveling circus to Colorado Springs, both Matthew and Dr. Mike try to help her self-conscious daughter.

episodes.title: Another Woman
episodes.summary: Mike's patient, a woman wounded during a massacre, falls for Sully; Loren thinks Dorothy is seeing more of Jake than him.

episodes.title: The Orphan Train
episodes.summary: Matthew, Colleen and Brian feel neglected when Dr. Mike and the Rev. Johnson search for families that will adopt orphans.

episodes.title: Buffalo Soldiers
episodes.summary: Sully and Michaela scout for information that will prevent further bloodshed when the Buffalo Soldiers arrive to confront renegade Indians.

episodes.title: Luck of the Draw
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike and Sully try to dissuade Matthew when a slick card shark teaches him to gamble and he believes he's found an easy way to make money.

episodes.title: Life and Death
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike clashes with Dorothy when she acts to protect her family from her friend's desperate son, who is addicted to morphine.

episodes.title: The First Circle
episodes.summary: A Denver banker brings the Ku Klux Klan to Colorado Springs to find new members and force Robert E to leave his home.

episodes.title: Just One Lullaby
episodes.summary: Mike suspects the new teacher, a good friend, abuses students; the Rev. Johnson is torn by feelings for the woman.

episodes.title: The Abduction (1)
episodes.summary: Blaming Mike for leading Custer's troops to them, renegade Indian soldiers abduct her; Sully vows to find her before she is killed.

episodes.title: The Abduction (2)
episodes.summary: Michaela is kidnapped by the dog soldiers, and Sully vows to find her before she is killed.

episodes.title: The Campaign
episodes.summary: Mike's mayoral candidacy sparks a debate on women's rights; Myra is assaulted by a customer Hank wanted her to entertain.

episodes.title: The Man in the Moon
episodes.summary: Hank, distraught at Myra's decision to leave the business, gets drunk. In his rage he shoots up the town, and winds up under Dr Mike's care in a coma.

episodes.title: Return Engagement (1)
episodes.summary: Mike's ex-fiance, whom she thought died in battle, comes to town forcing her to choose between him and Sully.

episodes.title: Return Engagement (2)
episodes.summary: When Mike discovers that a visiting naturalist is actually her former fiancé, a man she believed to have died in the war, she is forced to choose between him and Sully.

episodes.title: The Train
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike and Sully disagree over the changes the railroad will bring to Colorado Springs.

episodes.title: Fathers and Sons
episodes.summary: Loren plans a trip to Bolivia to prove he is not getting old; Brian seeks to prove his courage by camping out alone.

episodes.title: The Cattle Drive (1)
episodes.summary: Matthew inherits a herd of cattle after Olive dies, and the townspeople help him drive the herd to Colorado Springs.

episodes.title: The Cattle Drive (2)
episodes.summary: Matthew ignores Sully's advice about the land as he tries to prove his worth as a trail boss, but his inexperience endangers the lives of all those around him and leads to a stampede in which cattle are lost.

episodes.title: The Library
episodes.summary: Mike donates her father's book collection to start the town library, touching off a furor over censorship.

episodes.title: Halloween II
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike performs experimental reconstructive surgery on a disfigured man.

episodes.title: A Washington Affair (1)
episodes.summary: Mike, Sully and Cloud Dancing head to Washington, D.C., to lobby on behalf of the Indians; Sully is jailed as a deserter; assassins target President Grant; Mike's life is endangered.

episodes.title: A Washington Affair (2)
episodes.summary: In Washington, Dr Mike and Sully struggle to find anyone who'll listen to them. Michaela tries to break Sully out of jail, after he's arrested for army desertion, and expose a conspiracy against the president.

episodes.title: Money Trouble
episodes.summary: Mike's offer to pay for supplies needed to finish the new house threatens Sully's pride; Myra and Horace consult Mike about Myra's sleepwalking.

episodes.title: Thanksgiving
episodes.summary: Mike feels responsible for friends who were robbed on the Denver stagecoach; the kids prepare Thanksgiving dinner.

episodes.title: Ladies' Night (1)
episodes.summary: Dorothy ignores Mike's advice after finding a lump in her breast; maturing Colleen endures ridicule from boys.

episodes.title: Ladies' Night (2)
episodes.summary: Dorothy insists the decision to have surgery is hers, not Mike's; Colleen finds the harassment unbearable.

episodes.title: A First Christmas
episodes.summary: When an immigrant Jewish family arrives in Colorado Springs just before Christmas, the residents of town start to question what having the Christmas spirit means to them.

episodes.title: The Indian Agent
episodes.summary: Appointed by the government to represent Indian rights, Sully learns his supervisor is selling goods intended for the Cheyenne to local merchants.

episodes.title: The End of the World
episodes.summary: The townspeople spend what they believe will be their last days on Earth in a state of panic after a newspaper reports that a deadly comet is coming.

episodes.title: Pike's Peace
episodes.summary: Mike meets a kindred soul in an older woman who comes to climb Pikes Peak; Grace deals with her jealousy of Myra's pregnancy.

episodes.title: Cooper vs. Quinn (1)
episodes.summary: Mike and Sully attempt to adopt Brian and Colleen, but the arrival of their birth father and his wife complicates their plans.

episodes.title: Cooper vs. Quinn (2)
episodes.summary: Brian and Colleen flee so their father won't be able to take them away from Dr Mike and Sully. Dr Mike realises she has to let them go after they're discovered and Colleen has pneumonia.

episodes.title: What is Love?
episodes.summary: Passions explode when the townspeople start casting a production of "Romeo and Juliet"; Dr. Mike and Sully try to plan a day alone.

episodes.title: Things My Father Never Gave Me
episodes.summary: Mike's faith in Robert E. leads her to recommend him for the dangerous job of repairing a steam engine.

episodes.title: Baby Outlaws
episodes.summary: After the visiting Belle Starr gets into a bar fight, she stays with Dr. Mike and disrupts her peaceful home life.

episodes.title: Bone of Contention
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike and Sully try to stop a paleontologist who is digging up Cheyenne burial sites while searching for dinosaur bones.

episodes.title: Permanence of Change
episodes.summary: Substitute instructor Mike gets in trouble for teaching evolution theory; Mike takes an abused girl under her wing.

episodes.title: Washita (1)
episodes.summary: Mike and Sully arrive too late to avert Custer's slaughter of the Cheyenne Indians.

episodes.title: Washita (2)
episodes.summary: Sully and the kids try to help Mike deal with the emotional aftermath of the Washita massacre.

episodes.title: Sully's Recovery
episodes.summary: Sully must overcome his spiritual crisis in order to save Loren, who has been critically injured in the wilderness.

episodes.title: Ready or Not
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike and Sully remember the events that have marked their love affair and have second thoughts about their impending nuptials (featuring past episodes).

episodes.title: For Better or Worse (1)
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike's mother and sisters arrive with elaborate wedding plans; Gen. Custer places a bounty on Cloud Dancing, Sully's best man.

episodes.title: For Better or Worse (2)
episodes.summary: The arrival of the railroad brings surprises for Dr Mike and Sully's wedding day.

episodes.title: A New Life
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike and Sully's return from their honeymoon is marred by the arrival of a greedy banker and Cloud Dancing's hatred of the reservation.

episodes.title: Traveling All-Stars
episodes.summary: Baseball fever hits town when an all-star team arrives; the townspeople agree to split profits from a match with the traveling challengers.

episodes.title: Mothers and Daughters
episodes.summary: Mike becomes more absorbed in her new role as wife; rebellious Colleen joins schoolmates for dangerous and questionable escapades

episodes.title: Brother's Keeper
episodes.summary: Matthew's fiancee, Ingrid, is making final wedding plans when she is attacked by Brian's rabid dog and becomes gravely ill.

episodes.title: Halloween III
episodes.summary: Though an elderly patient believes the springs are helping him, Dr. Mike knows his improvements are psychological; Mike wants Sully to play Prince Charming.

episodes.title: Dorothy's Book
episodes.summary: Dorothy Jennings' book about her experiences in Colorado Springs becomes a best seller, but it angers townsfolk.

episodes.title: Promises, Promises
episodes.summary: Loren proposes to Dorothy but has a stroke before she can answer; an old friend wants Sully to come to the gold fields.

episodes.title: The Expedition (1)
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike celebrates her birthday by climbing Pikes Peak with Dorothy, Grace and Myra, but ends up injured and alone when her companions turn back.

episodes.title: The Expedition (2)
episodes.summary: On her birthday, Dr Mike winds up injured and alone on Pike Peak after Dorothy, Grace, and Myra turn back on a celebratory climb. Preston decides to build a casino back in town.

episodes.title: One Touch of Nature
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike fears she is unable to have a child because of her age; the townspeople debate sharing their feast with the Cheyenne on the reservation.

episodes.title: Hell on Wheels
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike finds a heartbroken and self-destructive Matthew courting danger in a plague-ridden town.

episodes.title: Fifi's First Christmas
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike gets a mischievous poodle; Brian is smitten with a new girl in town; the Rev. Johnson recruits folk for a Nativity pageant.

episodes.title: Change of Heart
episodes.summary: Robert E wants to adopt a sick boy, but Grace is hesitant about becoming attached; Dr. Mike struggles to diagnose the child.

episodes.title: Tin Star
episodes.summary: Matthew becomes sheriff of Colorado Springs, and his first challenge is a confrontation with an infamous gunslinger.

episodes.title: If You Love Someone
episodes.summary: Matthew's grief finally gives way to a new romance, but his heart goes to a woman working for Hank in the brothel.

episodes.title: The Ice Man Cometh
episodes.summary: During Dr. Mike's absence, the residents of Colorado Springs become prey to a con man.

episodes.title: Dead or Alive (1)
episodes.summary: Sully leads the rescue when a boy is kidnapped by a mountain man; Dr. Mike's pregnancy is in danger when she does not take care of herself.

episodes.title: Dead or Alive (2)
episodes.summary: Sully leaves the unruly rescue party to hunt for Matthew on his own; Dr. Mike's least favorite physician takes over her practice.

episodes.title: Deal with the Devil
episodes.summary: When the Rev. Johnson finds his former mentor plans a visit, he borrows money from Hank to fix up his ramshackle church.

episodes.title: Eye for an Eye
episodes.summary: Capital punishment divides Colorado Springs when a man convicted of rape and murder is sentenced to die.

episodes.title: Hearts and Minds
episodes.summary: Cloud Dancing sees a reservation school as fatal to Indian culture; bankers stonewall Dorothy's loan request.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike's joyful reunion with a college friend soon turns competitive; Dorothy struggles with a new press.

episodes.title: Woman of the Year
episodes.summary: After being nominated for Colorado's Woman of the Year, Dr. Mike finds it nearly impossible to live up to everyone's expectations.

episodes.title: Last Chance
episodes.summary: A renegade stabs Cloud Dancing, and Emma has a tumor, so Mike cannot slow down before the baby is born.

episodes.title: Fear Itself
episodes.summary: The residents of Colorado Springs welcome an artist until they discover she carries a disease, causing Dr. Mike to face her own fears.

episodes.title: One Nation
episodes.summary: Cloud Dancing claims responsibility when a young soldier is inadvertently shot during a fight between the Army and the American Indians.

episodes.title: When a Child is Born (1)
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike prepares for the birth of her baby; Sully is hurt while trying to rescue Cloud Dancing and others from Sgt. O'Connor and his patrol.

episodes.title: When a Child is Born (2)
episodes.summary: Cloud Dancing leads pregnant Dr. Mike through the wilderness to Sully; Dr. Cook is forced to perform a major operation.

episodes.title: Runaway Train
episodes.summary: Robbers wreck a train carrying Sully and Cloud Dancing; Andrew is reluctant to return the practice to Dr. Mike.

episodes.title: Having It All
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike finds the stresses of being a wife, mother and career woman too much and contemplates turning her practice over to Dr. Cook.

episodes.title: Malpractice
episodes.summary: A malpractice suit prevents Dr. Mike from practicing medicine, leaving the reluctant Dr. Cook in charge.

episodes.title: All That Glitters
episodes.summary: The appearance of renowned singer Gilda St. Clair tempts Colleen to leave college and travel the world instead.

episodes.title: Los Americanos
episodes.summary: A Latin American woman rebuffs Dr. Mike's attempts at friendship; the Rev. Johnson searches for a teacher to take his place.

episodes.title: Last Dance
episodes.summary: Sully gets an offer to survey the newly created Yellowstone National Park; Brian's first date; Dorothy teaches Cloud Dancing ballroom steps.

episodes.title: Right or Wrong
episodes.summary: Jake and Preston each want Mike's mayoral endorsement, until she is jailed for treating a fugitive Indian.

episodes.title: Remember Me
episodes.summary: When a sick, old prospector wanders into town, Dr. Mike takes it upon herself to help reunite him with his family before it's too late after she tends to his ailments, one of which is the onset of dementia. However, she is unaware that Jake is the old man's son and he abandoned his family when Jake was still a child. After Brian announces that the prospector found a large nugget of gold nearby, Mr. Bray, Horace, and Hank catch gold fever.

episodes.title: Legend
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike, Sully and Matthew team up with a legendary marshal in order to nab the thieves who wounded Matthew during a bank robbery.

episodes.title: The Tempest
episodes.summary: A severe storm bears down on Colorado Springs, disrupting the arrival of Preston Lodge II and Dr. Mike's attempts to prepare a Thanksgiving dinner.

episodes.title: Separate But Equal
episodes.summary: Robert E. and Brian try to enroll Anthony in the all-white school; Jake and Hank open a hotel to rival Preston's.

episodes.title: A Place to Die
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike's practice is in jeopardy when her patients begin dying of a mysterious infection apparently contracted at the clinic.

episodes.title: Season of Miracles
episodes.summary: As Christmas approaches, Brian questions his faith when he learns that Dr. Mike cannot save the Rev. Johnson's sight.

episodes.title: The Dam
episodes.summary: In a case of mistaken motivation, a judge sends Sully to prison after he is spotted with criminals bent on stopping the construction of a dam.

episodes.title: Farewell Appearance
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike's Uncle Theodore, a concert pianist, sees in Brian not only a talented musician, but his own dead son.

episodes.title: The Most Fatal Disease
episodes.summary: Kid Cole and Sister Ruth visit Dr. Mike at a difficult time in their marriage.

episodes.title: Colleen's Paper
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike and Colleen recall past cases as part of a college course Colleen is taking; Andrew is overcome by a mysterious ailment. Features clips from previous episodes.

episodes.title: Between Friends (1)
episodes.summary: Sully's wealthy friend Daniel falls for Mike and humiliates Sully with an offer of financial help.

episodes.title: Between Friends (2)
episodes.summary: Sully is humiliated when his wealthy friend develops feelings for Mike, and presents them with an offer of financial help.

episodes.title: Hostage
episodes.summary: Despite being wounded by two bank robbers, Sully works to free his wife, Brian and Katie when they are taken hostage by the desperate men.

episodes.title: The Body Electric
episodes.summary: Brian takes a liking to visiting writer Walt Whitman, even when the townspeople shun Whitman over rumors of his alternative lifestyle.

episodes.title: Before The Dawn
episodes.summary: Horace attempts suicide after his wife leaves him, prompting Dr. Mike to send for her and their young daughter.

episodes.title: Starting Over
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike is shocked by her sister's liberal behavior and open relationship with Loren Bray after she joins the women's suffrage movement.

episodes.title: His Father's Son
episodes.summary: When Brian's irresponsible behavior puts the town in danger, Sully must step in and begin acting like a real father to the boy.

episodes.title: Moment of Truth (1)
episodes.summary: Defying government orders, Sully becomes a wanted man after he enters an American Indian reservation and helps Cloud Dancing escape.

episodes.title: Moment of Truth (2)
episodes.summary: When Sgt. McKay holds Sully responsible for the Dog Soldiers' attacks, he and Cloud Dancing escape to safer American Indian lands.

episodes.title: Reason to Believe
episodes.summary: Daniel Simon and Dr. Mike search for Sully, who is dying in the wilderness from injuries suffered when he fled the Cavalry.

episodes.title: All That Matters
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike keeps Sully's whereabouts a secret as she tries to help him recover from his wounds.

episodes.title: A Matter of Conscience
episodes.summary: Hank, believing Sully and Cloud Dancing to be the instigators of the American Indian raids, declares himself sheriff and sets off to capture them.

episodes.title: The Comfort of Friends
episodes.summary: With Sully still in hiding, Dr. Mike worries that she may be pregnant again, a secret that spreads quickly throughout the town.

episodes.title: Wave Goodbye
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike is shocked when a Russian princess convinces the townsfolk she is a seer with ties to the spirit world

episodes.title: A Place Called Home
episodes.summary: Grace and Robert E.'s adopted son may not survive; fugitive Sully works for peace and learns of Mike's miscarriage.

episodes.title: Lead Me Not
episodes.summary: Mike's sister Marjorie is a temperance crusader; Sully and Cloud Dancing try reasoning with Black Moon.

episodes.title: A Time to Heal (1)
episodes.summary: Mike sends the children to Sully's hideout, but her visiting family refuses to leave diphtheria-ravaged Colorado Springs.

episodes.title: A Time to Heal (2)
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike tries to protect her family from a diphtheria epidemic, but her mother and two sisters refuse to leave town.

episodes.title: Civil Wars
episodes.summary: Matthew's legal studies lead to a flurry of lawsuits after Horace seeks restitution from Hank for accidentally breaking his nose.

episodes.title: Safe Passage
episodes.summary: An Indian-hater determines to thwart a treaty that would allow Black Cloud's warriors safe passage and let Sully come home.

episodes.title: The Homecoming
episodes.summary: Returning from the reservation, Dr. Mike and Sully hope to make it home for Christmas, but are waylaid when they help a young couple lost in the wilderness.

episodes.title: Point Blank
episodes.summary: Sully and the townsfolk worry about Dr. Mike when she begins having recurring nightmares after being shot by a man with a hatred of doctors.

episodes.title: Seeds of Doubt
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike's dislike of Colleen's charming but rather aggressive boyfriend is validated when Andrew has to protect Colleen from abuse.

episodes.title: Seven Kinds of Lonely
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike tries to prevent grief-stricken Loren from moving away; the town prepares for the "Sweethearts Dance."

episodes.title: Life in the Balance
episodes.summary: Dr. Quinn befriends a young Chinese woman who must pretend to be a man so she can practice medicine.

episodes.title: Happily Ever After
episodes.summary: Teresa's aunt tries to stop her from marrying Jake; Dorothy wants to free Cloud Dancing and run away with him.

episodes.title: Birdman
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike learns that a strange but seemingly harmless man whom Brian has befriended is actually an escapee from an insane asylum.

episodes.title: Vengeance
episodes.summary: Matthew defends lawman Elias Burch against charges that he murdered an unarmed ex-con.

episodes.title: To Have and to Hold
episodes.summary: Mike and Sully reminisce about ups and downs of their relationship when a head injury forces Mike to stay awake or risk a coma. * Another flashback episode featuring clips from past episodes.

episodes.title: The Fight
episodes.summary: After the death of his son and the breakup of his marriage, furious Robert E. fights a visiting boxing champion.

episodes.title: A New Beginning
episodes.summary: Medical student Colleen accepts Andrew's proposal; Preston offers to buy Jake's share of the Golden Nugget.
